ai_summary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited has announced a record date of September 22, 2026, for a substantial final dividend of Rs. 37 per equity share for FY 2025-26. This high payout, representing 370% of the share's face value, signifies a strong return to shareholders and will result in a significant cash outflow for the company upon approval at the September 29, 2026 Annual General Meeting. No immediate red flags are present, as this appears to be a standard regulatory announcement for a significant shareholder distribution.
